name: The Instagrammer
dream: Become the brand — fame that pays
story: 99.8% of her days end in the red, kept afloat by ₦22.8m of bailouts. Her feed projects ₦242m of life against ₦1.1m of real brand income. In reality some creators do break through and get wealthy — the simulator will let you trigger that breakthrough.
caveat: Her spending is real; her wealth is performed. The dream line measures content investment, not assets you could sell.

milestones.item: Opens the lifestyle account; first posts
Hits 10k followers -- buys ring light + phone (BNPL)
First small brand gig (lash vendor) -- N40k
Sponsor support starts funding the lifestyle
Brand-ambassador pitch to a big label -- rejected
BNPL + friend loans overdue; juggling repayments
Reassessing -- the gap between feed and bank
A few thousand followers, near-zero real income
Arc ends -- the dream is still mostly a projection
